stem: Which sentence from the selection describes one way that puzzles have changed?

options.label: A
options.text: People solve jigsaw puzzles by fitting small pieces together to make a whole. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: Jigsaw puzzles soon became a popular form of group entertainment. (paragraph 5)

options.label: C
options.text: These new puzzles had pieces that had to be fitted together to create an image that rose into the air. (paragraph 7)

options.label: D
options.text: Working on puzzles has been linked to better memory and concentration as well. (paragraph 9)
